source: RFC 0006 §8.1; round-2 review M3 of the backends
statement: A rate limit rule's window is at most a day (windowSeconds from 1 to 86400): a counter key lives two windows in a Redis that must not evict, one key per bucket value, so a long window keyed by something a client chooses would be memory the client controls. A document with a longer window does not decode (a stored one is installed as failed, and the control plane refuses a change that makes one), and the schema says the same.
guards: model:DecisionTest#a rate limit spec is bounded
